_comment: The directory name is the PRODUCTION HOSTNAME, because that is what
js/cms-config.js resolves a visitor's location.hostname against.
siteId is 'playzone9app', NOT 'playzone9'. That is not a typo and it
matters more than it looks: 'playzone9' is JSK1's row -- the name
predates the JSK1 rename -- so a brand using it would read and write
JSK1's live content. The two must never share a row, and the awkward
name is the price of not migrating live data.
mediaBucket is separate for the same reason: separate buckets are what
make one brand's media URLs invalid for another.
name: Playzone9
_environments_comment: The brand is Playzone9. playzone9.app is the domain it will LAUNCH on
and is reserved: no deployment, no DNS, nothing points at it yet.
playzones9.com is where it is reviewed first.
The staging host is declared HERE rather than by renaming this brand,
because the brand and the hostname are different things. Renaming would
mean renaming back at launch -- directory, id, Supabase row, every test
that names it -- to change nothing about the brand.
siteId is its own: a review copy sharing the production row would
publish over production. NEITHER row exists yet; both render from
brand.js. noindex makes every staging page noindex,nofollow and
replaces the sitemap with a robots.txt that blocks everything.
